Cowork 上手實戰The Cowork Playbook

跟著做，套用到你的日常Do it. Then make it yours.

不只是會聊天的 AI，是會動手幫你把事做完的代理式 Copilot。Not an AI that just chats — the agentic Copilot that gets the work done.

8 個真實業務情境，從讀檔、寫文件、跑數據到對外溝通，帶你看 Cowork 如何自己規劃、執行，並在每個對外動作前停下來等你核准。看完就動手，再換成你自己的工作。8 real business scenarios — from reading files and writing documents to crunching data and communicating outbound. Watch Cowork plan, execute, and pause for your approval before every outbound action. Then make it your own.

Screenshots show one actual run, not an expected answer — verify against the "Acceptance checklist" rather than expecting an identical screen.

公部門 · 政策研究Government · Policy Research

跨方案政策研究Cross-Program Policy Research

⏱ 約 15–20 分鐘 · 難度 ★★☆⏱ ~15–20 min · Level ★★☆

把一份跨方案政策研究需求交給 Cowork，讓它先用 Enterprise Search 盤點機關內部（OneDrive／SharePoint）是否已有相關研究，避免重工，再針對缺口做外部研究補充，最後交由 Word 整理成一份來源分清楚的跨方案比較簡報 —— 不是開一次 Chat 問一次答、自己去對照兩個模型的答案，而是內部知識優先、外部驗證在後的一次多技能接力。Hand Cowork a cross-program policy research request and let it first use Enterprise Search to check whether this agency (OneDrive/SharePoint) already has related research — avoiding duplicate work — then fill only the remaining gaps with external research, and finally have Word assemble a comparison briefing with sources clearly labeled. Instead of a one-off Chat Q&A where you compare two models' answers yourself, this is a repeatable, multi-skill relay that checks internal knowledge first and validates externally second.

會用到的技能Skills usedEnterprise SearchWord

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是機關政策幕僚，長官交辦要研究其他國家或主管機關對某項政策議題（如無人機空域管理）的做法，且特別要求「先確認機關內部是否已經做過類似研究」，避免重工，再視需要補充最新外部趨勢，寫成一份跨方案比較簡報。過去的做法通常是開 Copilot Chat 一次問一次答，自己去對照不同模型的回答，缺點是查不到機關內部真正已有的文件，也無法保證每次都用同一套流程。這個情境示範 Cowork 如何先用 Enterprise Search 掃過內部既有資料，找出既有基礎，再視缺口做外部研究，最後交棒給 Word 整理成正式簡報。You are a policy staffer at a government agency. Leadership has asked you to research how other countries or authorities handle a policy topic (e.g. UAS airspace management), specifically requiring you to first confirm whether the agency already has similar internal research before duplicating the work, then supplement with the latest external trends as needed, and write it up as a cross-program comparison briefing. The old way was one-off Copilot Chat Q&A, comparing different models' answers yourself — which cannot surface documents that already exist inside the agency, and offers no repeatable process. This scenario shows Cowork first sweeping internal material with Enterprise Search to establish what already exists, researching externally only for the gaps, then handing off to Word to produce the formal briefing.

📂參考檔案Reference files

  • 📎GOV1_政策研究需求與比較框架.mdGOV1_Policy_Research_Request_and_Comparison_Framework.md跨方案政策研究需求（比較範圍、內部盤點要求、交付格式）Cross-program policy research request (comparison scope, internal-inventory requirement, deliverable format)

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

上傳研究需求，請它先用 Enterprise Search 盤點內部既有資料Upload the research request and have it first inventory internal material with Enterprise Search

把研究需求 md 上傳後，第一步一定要先請它搜尋機關內部（OneDrive／SharePoint）是否已有相關研究、簡報或會議紀錄，並列出清單與重點摘要。這一步的重點是「先盤點，再研究」，避免你和 Cowork 一起重新做一次機關早就做過的功課。After uploading the research-request md, the first step must be asking it to search this agency's internal material (OneDrive/SharePoint) for related research, briefings or meeting notes, and list them with key-point summaries. The point of this step is "inventory first, research second" — so you and Cowork don't redo work the agency has already done.

提示詞Prompt
附件是本次跨方案政策研究需求。請先使用 Enterprise Search 幫我搜尋我們機關內部（OneDrive／SharePoint）是否已有相關研究、簡報或會議紀錄，列出找到的既有文件清單與重點摘要，避免我們重複研究。Attached is this cross-program policy research request. Please first use Enterprise Search to check whether our agency (OneDrive/SharePoint) already has related research, briefings or meeting notes — list any existing documents found with key-point summaries so we avoid duplicating the research.
2

觀察內部盤點結果，決定外部研究的範圍Review the internal-inventory results and scope the external research

Cowork 執行 Enterprise Search 後，會列出組織內部相符文件與重點摘要 —— 這裡要看的是它有沒有真的找到「這機關真實存在」的文件，而不是憑空生成看似合理的清單。基於這份盤點結果，再明確告訴它哪些面向內部尚未涵蓋，只針對缺口做外部研究，藉此把 Deep Research 等級的查證範圍縮小到真正需要的部分。After Cowork runs Enterprise Search, it lists internal documents that match, with key-point summaries — check whether it genuinely found documents that exist in this agency, rather than fabricating a plausible-looking list. Based on this inventory, tell it explicitly which dimensions the internal material does not cover, and have it research externally only for those gaps — narrowing a Deep-Research-scale verification effort down to only what is actually needed.

提示詞Prompt
根據以上盤點，請針對「內部尚未涵蓋」的面向，用網路研究補充其他國家╱主管機關的最新做法，並附上來源連結。Based on the inventory above, please use web research to supplement the dimensions the internal material does not yet cover, describing the latest practices of other countries / authorities, with source links attached.
3

交由 Word 整理成跨方案政策比較簡報，來源分內部／外部標示Have Word assemble the cross-program comparison briefing, labeling internal vs. external sources

最後一步換技能：把內部盤點結果與外部研究一起交給 Word，整理成一份正式簡報。這裡刻意要求「每個重點都要標示來源是內部既有資料還是外部研究」，這樣長官看到報告時，能清楚分辨哪些是機關既有的判斷、哪些是這次新補上的外部資訊，而不是被混在一起、分不清楚。The final step hands off to Word: combine the internal inventory and the external research into a formal briefing document. Deliberately require that every point be labeled as sourced from existing internal material or new external research — so leadership reading the report can clearly tell which points reflect the agency's existing judgment and which are freshly supplemented external information, rather than having everything blended together.

提示詞Prompt
請把以上內部盤點與外部研究整理成一份 Word「跨方案政策比較簡報」，用表格呈現各國╱機關的做法、法規框架與責任歸屬，並在每個重點後標示資料來源是「內部既有資料」還是「外部研究」。Please assemble the internal inventory and external research above into a Word "cross-program policy comparison briefing," presenting each country's / authority's approach, regulatory framework and accountability structure in table form, with each point labeled as sourced from "existing internal material" or "external research."

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

內部搜尋與外部研究整理都屬於唯讀彙整工作，不會觸發審核卡；但因為這份報告要呈送長官作為決策參考，你仍應核實兩件事：「內部既有文件」是否真的與本次議題相關（避免張冠李戴），以及外部來源是否可靠、且已清楚標示。若下一步要把報告轉發給其他單位或簽陳長官，才會進入寄送前的核准流程。Both the internal search and the external research write-up are read-only compilation work, so no approval card appears. But because this report goes to leadership for a decision, you should still verify two things: that the "existing internal material" is genuinely relevant to this topic (avoiding a mismatch), and that external sources are reliable and clearly labeled. If you next forward the report to another unit or route it to leadership for sign-off, that enters the approve-before-send flow.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • Enterprise Search 有實際找到機關內部文件並列出重點摘要，而非憑空生成Enterprise Search actually found agency-internal documents and summarized them, rather than fabricating a list
  • 外部研究確實聚焦在內部尚未涵蓋的缺口，而非重複盤點過的內容The external research genuinely focuses on the gaps the internal material does not cover, not content already inventoried
  • 比較簡報清楚標示每一筆資訊的來源是「內部既有」或「外部研究」The comparison briefing clearly labels each point as sourced from "existing internal material" or "external research"
  • 語氣中性客觀，適合作為長官決策參考，未加入未經查證的推測The tone stays neutral and objective, suitable for a leadership decision, with no unverified speculation added

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 換成你機關真正關注的政策議題，例如電動垂直起降場管理或空域壅塞收費機制。Swap in the policy topic your agency actually cares about, such as eVTOL vertiport management or airspace congestion pricing.
  • 請它額外整理一份「決策選項與利弊」摘要頁，方便長官快速比較。Ask it to prepare an additional "decision options and trade-offs" summary page for leadership to compare quickly.
  • 若要跨部門分享，先用 Email 或 Teams 走核准流程再寄出，不要直接轉發草稿。If you need to share it across units, route it through the Email or Teams approval flow first rather than forwarding the draft directly.

公部門 · 預算管理Government · Budget Management

預算執行率查核Budget Execution Rate Review

⏱ 約 10–12 分鐘 · 難度 ★★☆⏱ ~10–12 min · Level ★★☆

把各科室的預算執行原始數據交給 Cowork，讓它在 Excel 中驗算執行率與進度落差、標示落後的科目，核准後再由它直接寄信提醒對應承辦人儘速執行 —— 從單純的 Excel 內部驗算，延伸成一次真正跨系統的提醒動作。Hand Cowork the raw budget-execution data across sections and let it verify each program's execution rate and schedule gap in Excel, flagging items that are behind — then, once you approve, have it email the responsible officers a reminder directly. This extends beyond in-Excel verification into a real cross-system notification step.

會用到的技能Skills usedExcelEmail

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是主計或企劃管考單位的承辦，每季要核對各科室、各計畫科目的預算執行率，抓出落後進度的科目並提醒承辦同仁儘速執行。過去的做法通常只在 Excel 內驗算金額與百分比，查核完就結束了，提醒與否要另外手動處理。這個情境延伸一步：查核表確認無誤、你按下核准後，Cowork 直接依查核結果寫信提醒每一位落後科目的承辦人 —— 但因為寄信屬於對外動作，它會先停在核准卡讓你逐一確認，而不是自動亂發。You work in budget control or planning at a government agency, and every quarter you need to verify budget-execution rates across sections and program items, flagging anything behind schedule and reminding the responsible officers. The old approach usually stopped at verifying figures and percentages inside Excel — reminding people afterward was a separate manual step. This scenario extends one step further: once the verification table is confirmed and you approve, Cowork emails every officer whose item is behind schedule directly. Because sending email is an outbound action, it pauses at an approval card for you to check each message individually rather than auto-sending anything.

📂參考檔案Reference files

  • 📎GOV2_預算執行數據.xlsxGOV2_Budget_Execution_Data.xlsx各科室計畫科目、編列金額、累計動支、當季應達成進度、承辦人Program items by section, budgeted amount, cumulative spend, target progress this quarter, responsible officer

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

上傳原始數據，請它在 Excel 中驗算執行率並標示落後科目Upload the raw data and have it verify execution rates and flag lagging items in Excel

把原始 xlsx 上傳時，直接講清楚計算方式：執行率 = 累計動支 ÷ 編列金額，進度落差 = 實際執行率 − 當季應達成進度，並要求標示落差超過一定門檻的科目。你把驗算邏輯講得越精確，Cowork 產出的查核表就越接近真正能拿去用的版本，而不是一份看起來漂亮但算法含糊的報表。When you upload the raw xlsx, state the calculation explicitly: execution rate = cumulative spend ÷ budgeted amount, schedule gap = actual execution rate − target progress this quarter, and ask it to flag items whose gap exceeds a threshold. The more precisely you specify the calculation logic, the closer Cowork's verification table gets to something genuinely usable, rather than a report that looks polished but has vague math underneath.

提示詞Prompt
附件是本季各科室的預算執行原始數據。請幫我在 Excel 中驗算每個科目的「執行率」（累計動支/編列金額）與「進度落差」（實際執行率 − 當季應達成進度），標示出落後超過 10 個百分點的科目，並加上一段重點發現。Attached is this quarter's raw budget-execution data by section. Please verify each program item's "execution rate" (cumulative spend / budgeted amount) and "schedule gap" (actual execution rate − target progress this quarter) in Excel, flag items lagging by more than 10 percentage points, and add a short findings section.
2

檢查驗算結果與落後標示是否正確Check whether the verification and lagging flags are correct

打開產出的 Excel，抽查幾個科目的執行率與進度落差是否算對、被標示落後的科目是否真的超過門檻、重點發現是否忠於數字。這一步是你在核准寄信前最後的把關 —— 確保接下來要提醒的對象與內容是正確的。Open the generated Excel and spot-check a few items: is the execution rate and schedule gap calculated correctly, are the flagged lagging items genuinely over the threshold, and do the written findings stay faithful to the numbers? This is your last check before approving the reminder emails — making sure who gets reminded, and about what, is correct.

3

核准後，請它寄信提醒落後科目的承辦人After approval, have it email the responsible officers of lagging items

查核表確認無誤後，這一步從「Excel 內驗算」延伸為「對外通知」——請 Cowork 依查核結果，為每個落後科目的承辦人各寫一封簡短提醒信。因為寄信屬於對外動作，Cowork 會先跳出核准卡，列出每一封信的收件者、主旨與內文，你需逐一確認，按下傳送才會真的寄出。Once the verification table is confirmed, this step extends from in-Excel checking to an outbound notification: ask Cowork to draft a short reminder email to each officer whose item is lagging, based on the verification results. Because sending email is an outbound action, Cowork pauses at an approval card listing every message's recipient, subject and body — you review each one and click send only after confirming.

提示詞Prompt
請針對進度落後的科目，各寫一封簡短提醒信給對應承辦人，說明目前執行率、應達成進度與落差，提醒儘速依原計畫執行，並副本我。For each program item that is behind schedule, please draft a short reminder email to the corresponding officer explaining the current execution rate, target progress and the gap, asking them to catch up per the original plan, and CC me.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

But once you ask it to email the responsible officers, that becomes an outbound (cross-section) action — Cowork pauses at an approval card listing every recipient, subject and body, and you must confirm each one before it actually sends, rather than broadcasting automatically.

The old approach usually stopped at annotating regulations in Word and handing it over — routing for signature was a separate manual step. This scenario extends one step further: once the regulation matching is done and you approve, Cowork prepares a sign-off summary and emails it to your supervisor requesting approval. Because sending email is an outbound (cross-level) action, it pauses at an approval card for you to confirm the content rather than sending automatically.

3

在文件中加註法規比對屬於內部準備工作，不會觸發審核卡；但一旦你要求 Cowork 把簽核摘要「寄送」給主管，就屬於對外（跨層級）動作，它會先停在核准卡，讓你檢查收件者、內容與附件，按下傳送後才會真的送出。這一步同時展現 Word→Email 的技能接力，也提醒你：法規適用的最終判斷仍是承辦人與機關法制單位的責任，Cowork 只是先整理出可供參考的依據。Annotating regulation matches in the document is internal preparation and does not trigger an approval card. But the moment you ask Cowork to email the sign-off summary to your supervisor, that becomes an outbound (cross-level) action — it pauses at an approve-before-send card so you can check the recipient, content and any attachment before clicking send. This step demonstrates the Word→Email skill hand-off, and is also a reminder that the final call on regulatory applicability remains the case officer's and the legal unit's responsibility — Cowork has only organized a reference basis.

  • 引用的法規條文經你或法制人員核實確實存在且適用The cited regulations have been verified by you or legal staff to actually exist and apply

This scenario hands Cowork a PDF listing multiple receipt line items and lets it recognize, categorize and consolidate them into an Excel list per the reimbursement rules, clearly flagging items missing a receipt or whose documentation type doesn't match the category — so you can remind staff directly instead of re-checking everything yourself.

1

上傳需求背景與範本，請 Word 起草 SOW 初稿Upload the requirement background and template, and have Word draft the SOW

上傳需求背景與範本 docx 後，請 Cowork 依範本結構（背景與目的、工作項目與範圍、履約期程、驗收標準、廠商資格、其他規定）起草 SOW 初稿。這一步只是把已知資訊填入正確的結構，重點是確認章節齊全，細節將在下一步依會議結論修正。After uploading the requirement-background-and-template docx, ask Cowork to draft the SOW following the template structure (background and purpose, scope of work, timeline, acceptance criteria, vendor qualifications, other provisions). This step is only about placing known information into the correct structure — the point is to confirm all sections are present, with details to be revised per the meeting decisions next.

提示詞Prompt
附件是採購案需求背景與工作說明書範本。請依範本結構幫我起草一份 SOW 初稿，涵蓋背景與目的、工作項目與範圍、履約期程、驗收標準、廠商資格與其他規定各段落。Attached is the procurement requirement background and SOW template. Please draft an SOW following the template structure, covering background and purpose, scope of work, timeline, acceptance criteria, vendor qualifications and other provisions.
2

上傳會議紀錄，請 Meetings 技能摘要決議重點Upload the meeting notes and have the Meetings skill summarize the decisions

接著換技能：把需求討論會議紀錄交給 Meetings 技能，請它摘要出會議中對規格或驗收條件的修正決議。這一步要看的是它有沒有精確抓出「改了什麼」，而不是整篇會議紀錄的空泛重述——例如期程從 4 個月延長為 5 個月、新增使用者實測要求，這些具體變動才是接下來要回頭改 SOW 的依據。This step switches skills: feed the requirement-discussion meeting notes to the Meetings skill and ask it to summarize the decisions that revised specs or acceptance conditions. What matters is whether it precisely captures what changed, rather than a vague restatement of the whole meeting — e.g. the timeline extended from 4 to 5 months, a new user-testing requirement was added. These concrete changes are exactly what will drive the SOW revision next.

提示詞Prompt
附件是這次採購需求討論的會議紀錄。請用 Meetings 技能摘要出會議中對規格、期程或驗收標準做了哪些修正決議，條列說明。Attached are the meeting notes from this procurement requirement discussion. Please use the Meetings skill to summarize what decisions were made that revised the specs, timeline or acceptance criteria, as a bullet list.
3

請它依會議決議回頭更新 SOW 草稿Have it revise the SOW draft per the meeting decisions

最後一步把兩個技能的產出接起來：請 Cowork 依剛剛摘要出的會議決議，回頭修改 SOW 初稿中對應的履約期程與驗收標準段落。驗收時要對照會議摘要逐條檢查，確認 SOW 是否真的反映了最新共識，而不是還停留在會議前的版本。The final step connects the two skills' outputs: ask Cowork to revise the corresponding timeline and acceptance-criteria sections of the SOW draft per the meeting decisions just summarized. When reviewing, check item by item against the meeting summary to confirm the SOW genuinely reflects the latest consensus rather than the pre-meeting version.

提示詞Prompt
請根據以上會議決議，回頭修改 SOW 草稿中的履約期程與驗收標準段落，確保文件反映最新共識，並在文件中標註本次修改的段落。Based on the meeting decisions above, please revise the timeline and acceptance-criteria sections of the SOW draft so the document reflects the latest consensus, and mark which sections were revised this round.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

起草與修改 SOW 屬於內部文件作業，不會觸發審核卡；但這份文件後續會作為招標公告的一部分對外發布，屬於高影響力文件，你應在文件送交採購作業前，逐段核對規格與驗收標準是否與最新會議共識一致，尤其是新增的資格或驗收條件，避免因遺漏而造成廠商爭議。若要把 SOW 送給其他單位會簽或對外發布，才會進入寄送或發布的核准流程。Drafting and revising the SOW is internal document work and does not trigger an approval card. But this document will eventually become part of a public tender announcement — a high-impact document — so before it goes into the procurement process, you should check section by section that the specs and acceptance criteria match the latest meeting consensus, especially any newly added qualification or acceptance condition, to avoid a vendor dispute from an omission. Sending the SOW to other units for co-signature or publishing it externally is when it enters the send/publish approval flow.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • SOW 初稿涵蓋範本要求的所有章節，沒有段落缺漏The SOW draft covers every section required by the template, with no missing parts
  • Meetings 摘要準確抓出會議中對規格、期程或驗收標準的具體修正The Meetings summary accurately captures the concrete revisions to specs, timeline or acceptance criteria from the meeting
  • SOW 更新後的履約期程與驗收標準與會議決議一致，且已標註修改段落The updated SOW's timeline and acceptance criteria match the meeting decisions, with revised sections marked
  • 文件中沒有出現與會議決議矛盾的舊版規格The document contains no outdated specs that contradict the meeting decisions

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把你機關常用的 SOW 章節或招標公告格式告訴 Cowork，讓草稿更貼近實務格式。Tell Cowork the SOW sections or tender-announcement format your agency typically uses, so the draft lands closer to your real format.
  • 請它額外整理一份「本次修改對照表」，列出修改前後差異，方便會簽單位快速核對。Ask it to prepare an additional "before/after comparison table" listing what changed, so co-signing units can check quickly.
  • 若後續有第二次需求會議，可再上傳新的會議紀錄，重複同樣的更新流程。If there is a second requirement meeting later, upload the new meeting notes and repeat the same update process.

公部門 · 計畫審查Government · Plan Review

計畫審查檢核技能Plan Review Checklist Skill

⏱ 約 12–15 分鐘 · 難度 ★★☆⏱ ~12–15 min · Level ★★☆

把計畫審查的固定標準（目標明確性、經費合理性、時程可行性、風險與配套）教給 Cowork，做成一個叫 plan-review-checklist 的自訂技能：之後只要上傳任何一份計畫書，就能一鍵產出結構化審查意見 —— 把你的審查標準變成機關可重複使用的資產。Teach Cowork your agency's fixed plan-review criteria — clarity of objectives, budget reasonableness, timeline feasibility, risks and mitigations — as a custom skill called plan-review-checklist. After that, uploading any plan document produces structured review comments with one click, turning your review standard into a reusable agency asset.

會用到的技能Skills used自訂技能 Skill

🎯情境背景Scenario

你可能每次審查各單位提報的計畫書，都要照同一套標準逐項檢查：目標是否明確可衡量、經費科目是否合理對應工作項目、時程是否可行、有沒有說明風險與配套。與其每次都重新口述一次審查標準，把這套標準寫成自訂技能 plan-review-checklist，讓 Cowork 之後看到任何計畫書都能照固定格式產出審查意見，而且對「資訊不足」的部分會誠實標示、不會自己臆測。You likely review plan documents submitted by various units against the same standard every time: are objectives specific and measurable, do budget items reasonably match the work, is the timeline feasible, and are risks and mitigations described? Instead of re-explaining the standard every time, encode it as a custom skill called plan-review-checklist, so Cowork produces structured review comments in a fixed format for any plan document — honestly flagging "insufficient information" rather than guessing.

📂參考檔案Reference files

  • 📎GOV6_SKILL.mdGOV6_SKILL_EN.md計畫審查檢核技能定義（六大審查段落與防護欄）Plan-review-checklist skill definition (six required review sections and guardrails)
  • 📎GOV6_計畫書範例.docxGOV6_Sample_Plan_Document.docx計畫書範例（含目標、經費編列、時程，風險段落刻意留空）Sample plan document (objective, budget, timeline; risk section deliberately left blank)

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

先問清楚技能如何建立與命名First confirm how the skill should be created and named

和一般 prompt 不同，自訂技能是會長期留在 OneDrive 的資產，所以先問 Cowork 技能命名、資料夾位置、SKILL.md 規格與生效方式。這一步能幫你確認 plan-review-checklist 這種 kebab-case 名稱可用，也讓你知道建立後通常要在新工作階段測試。Unlike a one-off prompt, a custom skill is a persistent asset stored in OneDrive, so first ask Cowork about naming, folder location, SKILL.md requirements and activation behavior. This confirms that a kebab-case name like plan-review-checklist is valid and reminds you that the skill usually needs a fresh session to test.

提示詞Prompt
我想在 Cowork 建立一個叫 plan-review-checklist 的自訂技能。請先說明自訂技能要放在哪裡、命名規則是什麼、SKILL.md 需要包含哪些核心欄位，以及建立後通常要怎麼測試是否已成功載入。I want to create a custom skill in Cowork called plan-review-checklist. Please first explain where custom skills are stored, what the naming rules are, which core fields SKILL.md needs, and how the skill is typically tested after creation to confirm it has loaded successfully.
2

請 Cowork 直接建立 plan-review-checklist 技能Ask Cowork to create the plan-review-checklist skill directly

接著把技能定義檔一起交給 Cowork，要求它建立 skill。關鍵要求要明確：內容需包含計畫基本資訊、目標明確性、經費合理性、時程可行性、風險與配套、綜合意見六大段落，且對資訊不足的部分必須明確標示「資訊不足」而非臆測。這些都應該固化成技能規則，而不是每次重講一次。Then provide the skill-definition file and ask Cowork to create the skill. Be explicit: the output must include six sections — plan basic info, clarity of objectives, budget reasonableness, timeline feasibility, risks and mitigations, and an overall recommendation — and any item with insufficient information must be explicitly flagged as such rather than guessed. These rules should be baked into the skill instead of re-explained every time.

提示詞Prompt
附件包含我想要的技能定義。請幫我建立一個名為 plan-review-checklist 的自訂技能，讓它能把任何一份計畫書依固定標準產出審查意見，內容需包含計畫基本資訊、目標明確性、經費合理性、時程可行性、風險與配套、綜合意見六大段落。若計畫書資訊不足以判斷某一項，須明確標示「資訊不足，請提報單位補充」，不得臆測。請直接建立它。The attachment contains the skill definition I want. Please create a custom skill named plan-review-checklist that reviews any plan document against a fixed standard, producing six sections: plan basic info, clarity of objectives, budget reasonableness, timeline feasibility, risks and mitigations, and an overall recommendation. If the plan document lacks enough information to judge an item, it must be explicitly flagged as "insufficient information — submitting unit should supplement" rather than guessed. Please create it directly.
3

開新工作階段，用一句話產出審查意見Open a new session and generate review comments with one phrase

技能建立後，開一個新工作階段，上傳一份計畫書範例，再用一句觸發語要求它做「計畫審查」。亮點在於不必重述任何審查標準，Cowork 依然照剛剛固化的邏輯逐項產出結構化意見。After the skill is created, open a fresh session, upload a sample plan document, and trigger it with one phrase asking for a "plan review." The standout is that no review standard needs to be re-explained — Cowork still follows the logic baked in moments ago to produce structured, item-by-item comments.

提示詞Prompt
請用 plan-review-checklist 幫我審查附件這份計畫書。Please use plan-review-checklist to review this attached plan document.
4

檢視技能是否誠實標示資訊不足、且能被分享Verify the skill honestly flags missing information and can be shared

打開產出的審查意見，重點檢查：範例計畫書中刻意留空的「風險與配套」段落，是否被誠實標示為「資訊不足，請提報單位補充」，而不是被憑空編出一段看似合理的風險描述。這是這個技能最重要的防護欄。最後打開技能詳細頁確認可以分享給同科室同事——這正是技能「持久化」的關鍵：不只是這次對話能用，而是變成機關可重複使用的資產。Open the generated review comments and specifically check: does the "risks and mitigations" section — deliberately left blank in the sample plan document — get honestly flagged as "insufficient information, submitting unit should supplement," rather than a plausible-sounding risk description being fabricated? This is the skill's most important guardrail. Finally, open the skill detail page to confirm it can be shared with colleagues in the same section — the key point of "persistence": not just usable in this conversation, but a reusable agency asset.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

建立技能本身只是把規則寫進 OneDrive 的持久化資產，不會觸發審核卡；用技能產生審查意見同樣是草稿性質的參考意見，最終審查結論仍須由你或審查委員會確認。真正該把關的是內容治理：技能是否誠實標示資訊不足、而非臆測；若你進一步要求把審查意見直接寄給提報單位或簽陳長官，才會進入對外動作的核准流程。Creating the custom skill is just writing a persistent rule asset into OneDrive, so it does not trigger an approval card; using it to generate review comments is still a draft-level reference opinion — the final review conclusion remains yours or the review committee's to confirm. The real control point is content governance: does the skill honestly flag insufficient information rather than guessing? If you then ask it to email the review comments directly to the submitting unit or route them to leadership, that is when it enters the outbound approval flow.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • plan-review-checklist 技能已建立，且規則包含六大固定段落與防護欄The plan-review-checklist skill is created with rules for the six required sections and guardrails
  • 新工作階段能用一句話觸發技能，不必重述審查標準A new session can trigger the skill with one phrase, without re-explaining the review standard
  • 對資訊不足的段落（如刻意留空的風險與配套）誠實標示，而非臆測Sections with insufficient information (such as the deliberately blank risk section) are honestly flagged rather than guessed
  • 技能已可分享給同科室同事，不只侷限這次對話The skill can be shared with colleagues in the same section, not limited to this one conversation

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 換成你機關實際的審查標準與計畫類型，一樣適用。Swap in your agency's actual review standard and plan type — the same approach applies.
  • 可以做一個變體，專門用於期中或期末成果報告審查。Create a variant specialized for mid-term or final outcome report reviews.
  • 若要把審查意見直接回覆提報單位，先確認內容再核准送出，而不是自動寄送。If you want to send the review comments directly to the submitting unit, review the content first, then approve sending — rather than sending automatically.

公部門 · 業務溝通Government · Public Affairs

議題問答準備Issue Q&A Prep

⏱ 約 12–15 分鐘 · 難度 ★★☆⏱ ~12–15 min · Level ★★☆

把一個近期可能被問到的議題背景交給 Cowork，讓它先用 Enterprise Search 盤點機關內部過去對類似議題的答詢紀錄與立場，再用 Word 整理成正式問答集，核准後 Email 給相關業務單位確認內容是否為最新進度 —— 用一般技能組合示範同樣的準備流程，而不建立長期技能。Hand Cowork the background of an issue leadership may soon be asked about, and let it first use Enterprise Search to inventory this agency's past internal responses and positions on similar issues, then use Word to compile a formal Q&A set, and after approval, email it to the relevant units to confirm the content reflects the latest progress — demonstrating the same prep workflow with a general skill combination rather than a persistent skill.

會用到的技能Skills usedEnterprise SearchWordEmail

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是幕僚，長官近期可能在業務會報或媒體詢問時被問到某個議題（如官網無障礙陳情增加），需要先準備一份問答集（Q&A）以備答詢。這類工作若已經很固定、每次都用同一套邏輯處理，通常會做成像 GOV6 那樣的持久化技能；但這裡刻意示範另一種做法——不建立技能，而是用一般技能組合走一次完整流程：先用 Enterprise Search 盤點機關內部過去對類似議題的正式答詢或會議結論，避免答詢口徑前後矛盾；再用 Word 整理成正式問答集；最後核准後 Email 給相關業務單位，確認內容是否為最新進度、有無需要更新之處。You are a staffer whose leadership may soon be asked about an issue (e.g. rising website-accessibility complaints) at an operations meeting or by the press, and you need to prepare a Q&A set in advance. If this kind of task is already routine and always handled the same way, it would typically become a persistent skill like GOV6; here we deliberately show a different approach — no skill is created, and a general skill combination runs the full workflow instead: first use Enterprise Search to inventory this agency's past formal responses or meeting conclusions on similar issues, avoiding a contradictory public position; then use Word to compile a formal Q&A set; finally, after approval, email it to the relevant units to confirm the content reflects the latest progress and flag anything needing an update.

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

1

上傳議題背景，請它先用 Enterprise Search 盤點過去答詢紀錄Upload the issue background and have it first inventory past responses with Enterprise Search

把議題背景 md 上傳後，第一步請 Cowork 用 Enterprise Search 搜尋機關內部是否已有對類似議題的正式答詢稿或會議結論。這一步的意義是避免這次擬的答詢口徑，和機關過去公開講過的立場互相矛盾。After uploading the issue-background md, the first step is asking Cowork to use Enterprise Search to check whether the agency already has formal response drafts or meeting conclusions on similar issues. The point is to avoid drafting a new position that contradicts what the agency has already said publicly.

提示詞Prompt
附件是一個長官近期可能被問到的議題背景。請先用 Enterprise Search 幫我盤點機關內部是否已有過去對類似議題的正式答詢稿或會議結論，列出找到的內容與重點摘要。Attached is the background of an issue leadership may soon be asked about. Please first use Enterprise Search to check whether this agency already has formal response drafts or meeting conclusions on similar issues, and list what you find with key-point summaries.
2

請 Word 整理成正式問答集初稿Have Word compile a formal Q&A draft

換技能：把盤點結果與議題背景交給 Word，針對每一題可能提問，整理出建議答詢要點，並附上資料來源（是延用過去立場，還是這次新擬）。這一步要看的是答詢要點是否具體、有依據，而不是空泛的場面話。Switch skills: give the inventory results and issue background to Word, and for each possible question, compile suggested talking points with the source noted (whether it reuses a past position or is newly drafted this time). 提示詞Prompt
請把以上盤點結果與附件議題背景整理成一份正式問答集，針對每一題可能提問給出建議答詢要點，並註明是延用過去立場還是本次新擬。Please compile the inventory results and the attached issue background into a formal Q&A set, giving suggested talking points for each possible question, and noting whether it reuses a past position or is newly drafted this time.
3

核准後，Email 給相關業務單位確認內容After approval, email the relevant units to confirm the content

問答集初稿完成後，這一步延伸為「跨單位確認」——請 Cowork 寫信給資訊管理科與秘書室，附上問答集，請他們確認內容是否為最新進度、有無需要更新之處。因為寄信屬於對外（跨科室）動作，Cowork 會先跳出核准卡列出收件者與內容，確認無誤才會送出。Once the Q&A draft is ready, this step extends into cross-unit confirmation: ask Cowork to email the IT Management Division and the Secretariat with the Q&A attached, asking them to confirm the content reflects the latest progress and flag anything needing an update. Because sending email is an outbound (cross-section) action, Cowork pauses at an approval card listing the recipients and content, sending only after you confirm.

提示詞Prompt
請把這份問答集整理成附件，寫信給資訊管理科與秘書室，請他們確認內容是否為最新進度、有無需要更新之處，並請於明天前回覆。Please attach this Q&A set and email the IT Management Division and the Secretariat, asking them to confirm the content reflects the latest progress and flag anything needing an update, and to reply by tomorrow.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

內部盤點與問答集整理屬於準備工作，不會觸發審核卡；但一旦要求 Cowork 把問答集「寄送」給其他業務單位確認，就屬於對外（跨科室）動作，它會先停在核准卡，讓你檢查收件者、內容與附件，按下傳送後才會真的送出。也請留意：問答集完成後仍應由長官或發言窗口最終核定答詢口徑，Cowork 只是先把可能被問到的內容整理清楚。The internal inventory and Q&A compilation are preparation work and do not trigger an approval card. But the moment you ask Cowork to email the Q&A set to other units for confirmation, that becomes an outbound (cross-section) action — it pauses at an approve-before-send card so you can check the recipients, content and attachment before clicking send. Also note that the final talking points should still be signed off by leadership or the spokesperson — Cowork has only organized what might be asked.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • Enterprise Search 有實際盤點出機關內部過去對類似議題的答詢或結論Enterprise Search actually inventoried the agency's past responses or conclusions on similar issues
  • 問答集每一題都附有具體答詢要點與資料來源標示Every question in the Q&A set has concrete talking points with the source labeled
  • 答詢口徑與機關過去公開立場一致，沒有自相矛盾The talking points are consistent with the agency's past public position, with no self-contradiction
  • 寄給業務單位確認的 Email 在你核准後才送出，收件者正確The confirmation email to the relevant units was sent only after your approval, with the correct recipients

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 換成你機關近期真正需要準備的議題，讓 Cowork 先盤點再整理問答集。Swap in the issue your agency actually needs to prepare for, and let Cowork inventory first before compiling the Q&A.
  • 請它額外整理一份給發言人參考的簡短版重點卡，只列 3–5 個核心訊息。Ask it to prepare an additional short reference card for the spokesperson, with only 3-5 core messages.
  • 若同類議題經常需要準備問答集，可考慮把整套流程固化成自訂技能，比照 GOV6／GOV8 的做法。If Q&A prep for similar issues is needed often, consider hardening the whole workflow into a custom skill, following the same approach as GOV6 / GOV8.

公部門 · 行政管理Government · Administration

例行月報彙總技能Routine Monthly Report Consolidation Skill

⏱ 約 12–15 分鐘 · 難度 ★★☆⏱ ~12–15 min · Level ★★☆

把承辦人本月零散的工作紀錄與月報寫作規則教給 Cowork，做成一個叫 monthly-ops-report 的自訂技能：之後只要上傳原始工作紀錄，就能一鍵產出機關固定格式的業務月報 —— 把原本只靠 Edit Word with Copilot 修改草稿的做法，升級成完整的技能建立情境。Teach Cowork a case officer's scattered monthly work log and the report-writing rules as a custom skill called monthly-ops-report: after that, uploading the raw work log produces the agency's standard-format operations report with one click — upgrading from simply editing a draft with Copilot in Word into a complete custom-skill scenario.

會用到的技能Skills used自訂技能 Skill

🎯情境背景Scenario

你每個月要把零散的工作紀錄整理成一份業務月報，交給科長或單位主管審閱。原始紀錄裡常常混有內部備註（例如對廠商態度的私下評語）、待確認的缺漏資訊，不能原封不動地交出去。這個情境示範把月報寫作規則寫成自訂技能 monthly-ops-report，讓 Cowork 自動過濾內部備註、把缺漏資訊誠實標示為「待確認」，並依固定格式產出正式月報，而不是每個月重新口述一次規則。Every month you need to turn a scattered work log into an operations report for your section chief or supervisor to review. The raw log often mixes in internal remarks (e.g. private comments about a vendor's attitude) and information still pending confirmation — none of which should go out as-is. This scenario shows how to encode the report-writing rules as a custom skill called monthly-ops-report, so Cowork automatically filters internal remarks, honestly flags missing information as "to be confirmed," and produces the formal report in a fixed format — instead of re-explaining the rules every month.

📂參考檔案Reference files

  • 📎GOV8_SKILL.mdGOV8_SKILL_EN.md例行月報彙總技能定義（六大固定段落與防護欄）Monthly-ops-report skill definition (six required sections and guardrails)
  • 📎GOV8_本月工作紀錄原始.mdGOV8_Monthly_Work_Log_Raw.md本月工作紀錄原始（含須過濾的內部備註與待確認事項）Raw monthly work log (with internal remarks to filter and items pending confirmation)

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

先問清楚技能如何建立與命名First confirm how the skill should be created and named

和一般 prompt 不同，自訂技能是會長期留在 OneDrive 的資產，所以先問 Cowork 技能命名、資料夾位置、SKILL.md 規格與生效方式。這一步能幫你確認 monthly-ops-report 這種 kebab-case 名稱可用，也讓你知道建立後通常要在新工作階段測試。Unlike a one-off prompt, a custom skill is a persistent asset stored in OneDrive, so first ask Cowork about naming, folder location, SKILL.md requirements and activation behavior. This confirms that a kebab-case name like monthly-ops-report is valid and reminds you that the skill usually needs a fresh session to test.

提示詞Prompt
我想在 Cowork 建立一個叫 monthly-ops-report 的自訂技能。請先說明自訂技能要放在哪裡、命名規則是什麼、SKILL.md 需要包含哪些核心欄位，以及建立後通常要怎麼測試是否已成功載入。I want to create a custom skill in Cowork called monthly-ops-report. Please first explain where custom skills are stored, what the naming rules are, which core fields SKILL.md needs, and how the skill is typically tested after creation to confirm it has loaded successfully.
2

請 Cowork 直接建立 monthly-ops-report 技能Ask Cowork to create the monthly-ops-report skill directly

接著把技能定義檔一起交給 Cowork，要求它建立 skill。關鍵要求要明確：內容需包含本月工作摘要、本月完成事項、進行中事項、下月工作計畫、待協調╱待簽核事項、風險與提醒六大段落，且必須過濾內部備註、不得杜撰未提及的工作項目、缺漏資訊須標示「待確認」。這些都應該固化成技能規則。Then provide the skill-definition file and ask Cowork to create the skill. Be explicit: the output must include six sections — monthly summary, completed items, in-progress items, next month's plan, items needing coordination/sign-off, and risks and reminders — and it must filter internal remarks, never fabricate work items not mentioned, and flag missing information as "to be confirmed." These rules should be baked into the skill.

提示詞Prompt
附件包含我想要的技能定義。請幫我建立一個名為 monthly-ops-report 的自訂技能，讓它能把承辦人零散的本月工作紀錄整理成月報，內容需包含本月工作摘要、本月完成事項、進行中事項、下月工作計畫、待協調╱待簽核事項、風險與提醒六大段落。技能必須過濾內部備註、不得杜撰未提及的工作項目，缺漏資訊須標示「待確認」。請直接建立它。The attachment contains the skill definition I want. Please create a custom skill named monthly-ops-report that turns a case officer's scattered monthly work log into a report with six sections: monthly summary, completed items, in-progress items, next month's plan, items needing coordination/sign-off, and risks and reminders. The skill must filter internal remarks, never fabricate work items not mentioned, and flag missing information as "to be confirmed." Please create it directly.
3

開新工作階段，用一句話產出本月月報Open a new session and generate this month's report with one phrase

技能建立後，開一個新工作階段，上傳本月工作紀錄原始檔，再用一句觸發語要求它做「本月業務月報」。亮點在於不必重述任何規則，Cowork 依然照剛剛固化的邏輯，過濾內部備註、產出結構化月報。After the skill is created, open a fresh session, upload the raw monthly work log, and trigger it with one phrase asking for "this month's operations report." The standout is that no rules need to be re-explained — Cowork still follows the logic baked in moments ago, filtering internal remarks and producing a structured report.

提示詞Prompt
請用 monthly-ops-report 幫我把附件整理成本月的業務月報。Please use monthly-ops-report to turn the attachment into this month's operations report.
4

檢視技能是否過濾內部備註、誠實標示待確認事項，且能被分享Verify the skill filters internal remarks, honestly flags pending items, and can be shared

打開產出的月報，重點檢查：原始紀錄中的內部備註（例如對廠商的私下評語）是否已被過濾掉，沒有出現在正式月報中；待確認的缺漏資訊是否誠實標示為「待確認」而非被杜撰補齊。最後打開技能詳細頁確認可以分享給同科室同事——這是技能「持久化」的關鍵：不只是這次對話能用，而是變成機關可重複使用的資產。Open the generated report and specifically check: have internal remarks from the raw log (like a private comment about a vendor) been filtered out and kept off the formal report; and is missing information honestly flagged as "to be confirmed" rather than fabricated? Finally, open the skill detail page to confirm it can be shared with colleagues in the same section — the key point of "persistence": not just usable in this conversation, but a reusable agency asset.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

建立技能本身只是把規則寫進 OneDrive 的持久化資產，不會觸發審核卡；用技能產生月報同樣是草稿製作。真正該把關的是內容治理：內部備註是否確實被過濾、缺漏資訊是否誠實標示待確認，而不是被杜撰補齊。若你進一步要求把月報直接寄給科長或主管，才會進入對外動作的核准流程。Creating the custom skill is just writing a persistent rule asset into OneDrive, so it does not trigger an approval card; using it to generate the monthly report is also still draft creation. The real control point is content governance: are internal remarks genuinely filtered out, and is missing information honestly flagged as pending rather than fabricated? If you then ask to send the report directly to your section chief or supervisor, that is when it enters the outbound approval flow.

  • 新工作階段能用一句話觸發技能，不必重述規則A new session can trigger the skill with one phrase, without re-explaining the rules
  • 原始紀錄中的內部備註已被過濾，未出現在正式月報中Internal remarks from the raw log have been filtered out and do not appear in the formal report
  • 缺漏資訊誠實標示為「待確認」，技能已可分享給同事Missing information is honestly flagged as "to be confirmed," and the skill can be shared with colleagues

  • 換成你自己單位的工作紀錄格式與月報章節要求，一樣適用。Swap in your own unit's work-log format and report-section requirements — the same approach applies.
  • 可以做一個變體，專門產生季報或年度工作報告。Create a variant specialized for quarterly or annual work reports.
  • 若要直接寄給科長，先確認內容再核准送出，而不是自動寄送。If you want to send it directly to your section chief, review the content first, then approve sending — rather than sending automatically.
